meta.question: on CUB (final, seeds 1-3, K=29), does the MaskedKD - Rollout / MaskedKD - TrustMask_v1 val NLL gap survive held-out 2-fold temperature scaling?
meta.method: per run, fit one softmax temperature on half of val (index parity), evaluate NLL and 15-bin ECE on the other half; paired MaskedKD@29 - selector@29 and selector@29 - Full for rollout/trustmask_v1/trustfilt/tome/random; image bootstrap and seed t CI
meta.paper: Guo et al. ICML 2017 (temperature scaling, ECE); Müller et al. NeurIPS 2019; Son et al. ECCV 2024 (MaskedKD); Wah et al. 2011 (CUB)
